MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The SanDisk card feels like a natural next purchase because I have repeatedly bought 16GB and 32GB memory cards with adapters, alongside a card reader and storage cases.",
    "The USB hub and extension cables support the accessories I already use by adding connection points and reach.",
    "The Fire TV Stick offers a useful new function for my TV: streaming. Its 4K capability is less relevant because my TV is 720p."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo devices and Blink bundle introduce uses I have not been pursuing. Buying photography accessories does not mean I want home surveillance or voice-controlled devices.",
    "The larger Fire tablet feels premature because I already have a Fire 7 and have bought accessories to support it; I have no specific reason to replace it.",
    "My cable purchases solve particular connection needs. Six one-foot Ethernet cables do not fit a need I currently have, and earbuds are not something I am seeking."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in a wider range of Amazon devices, although each would need to serve a useful purpose for me.",
    "My purchases of electronics and camera accessories seem to have been stretched into interest in almost any connected device."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of memory cards, adapters, a reader, and storage cases show an ongoing need to store, transfer, and organize files.",
    "I often buy accessories that help me keep using existing equipment. The connector, cable length, card format, and device compatibility matter more than a broad resemblance to something I own."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understood my need for storage and useful connections, but stretched my device ownership into interest in upgrades and smart-home equipment."
}
